facts.fact: The OECD Anti-Corruption and Integrity Outlook 2026 says the Access to Information Act No.4/2018 regulates every person's right to access information from a public body.

The OECD says the Information Commission is an independent body established under the Act, with a Chief Information Commissioner appointed for a fixed five-year term, and that it audited 19 institutions in 2023 with no fines applied.
